summary: Tested Daily Cash Dashboard + Bank Reconciliation Import feature (frontend-focused per main agent request, backend already verified via curl). Login, sidebar nav, Daily Cash date picker, Bank Reconciliation roadmap note, file upload, 3-tier matching (review/unmatched/matched/ignored tabs), link/unlink/ignore actions, and regression checks on Cash Ledger / Vendor Ledger / Partner Dues / Partner Billing — all PASSED. Also confirmed the 'Loading KDPS...' stuck-spinner concern raised by main agent is NOT reproducible — login and all routes render correctly; this was a tool/env artifact in the main agent's own session, not a real regression.
critical_code_review_comments: DailyCash.tsx and BankReconciliation.tsx are clean, well-commented, and use proper data-testid coverage on all interactive elements.

Matching engine correctly scopes candidates to BANK/UPI cash-ledger entries only — verified a CASH-account entry ('Playwright test payment', doc 26-27/HO/CASH/25) was correctly excluded from bank-line candidates, confirming the user's stated scope (BANK/UPI accounts only) is respected.

3-tier matcher works end-to-end: auto-matched rows show doc number + Unlink; needs-review rows show ranked candidates with score% + Link buttons; unmatched-with-no-candidates rows show only Ignore. Unlink correctly reverts a matched line back to 'Needs review' with its original candidate available for re-linking, and re-linking restores 'Matched' state — full round-trip verified.

Roadmap note (data-testid=bank-api-roadmap-note) renders exactly as specified, is non-interactive (static banner), and is a reasonable, low-effort way to satisfy the user's ask to acknowledge future bank-API sync.
No console errors or pageerrors observed during any flow (login, daily-cash, bank upload, link/unlink/ignore, regression pages).

success_rate.backend: not re-tested this iteration (already verified via curl by main agent)

Harmless test fixture, consistent with existing batches 1-4 already in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Daily Cash + Bank Reconciliation feature fully verified on frontend: login/sidebar nav, date picker refetch + empty state, upload flow, imports table row creation, all 5 tabs (all/review/unmatched/matched/ignored), link/unlink/ignore actions with full round-trip state transitions. Regression-checked Cash Ledger, Vendor Ledger, Partner Dues, Partner Billing — all load fine via client-side nav. IMPORTANT NOTE for automation: direct full-page browser navigation (page.goto) to a deep SPA route immediately after a fresh page load can render a blank/near-empty body for ~1-2s (observed on /money/vendor and /money/partner-billing) — this is a client-side routing/hydration timing artifact of goto+networkidle races, NOT an app bug; using sidebar link clicks (client-side nav) reliably avoids it. No stuck 'Loading KDPS...' spinner was ever observed on any route including /login — main agent's earlier concern was a tool/environment artifact in their own session.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration. The one thing worth flagging as an RCA note: main agent's 'Loading KDPS...' concern was investigated as first priority per instructions and could NOT be reproduced; app auth (httpOnly cookies), AuthContext bootstrap, and ProtectedRoute all function correctly across fresh logins and page loads in this testing session.
